criteria.statistic: per settled fixture d = LL(p_close) - LL(p_blend); p_blend = sigmoid((1-w)*logit(p_close) + w*logit(p_model)); positive = the frozen model adds information to the genuine close; the hypothesis is mean(d) > 0
criteria.model: first frozen scout_model row per fixture, frozen before kickoff

bootstrap.p_value: one-sided, normal approximation mean / block-bootstrap SE

discovery.family: all registered hypotheses; untestable ones enter with p = 1

confirmation.family: all hypotheses that ever entered confirmation; untestable ones p = 1

criteria.forward_start: confirmation_start = review time when discovery passes; write-once, never backdated

change_policy: Criteria are frozen by criteria_sha256. Changing any criterion is a NEW registry version with new registrations; confirmation_start is write-once.
